note: Shrink-only coverage allowance. Each entry records the exact, sorted, duplicate-free set of English key IDs that its (locale, namespace) does not yet carry, plus the owner and payoff date for that debt. tests/unit/i18n/test_language_manifest.py fails on any missing key NOT listed here — including a new key added to an already-incomplete namespace — and on any listed key that is no longer missing, so this file can only shrink. Adding an entry is a reviewed decision: it must name an owner and a payoff (ticket reference or ISO date) and reviewers must reject growth not tied to a real plan.

English-pinned by CALLER CONTRACT, not untranslated debt: these diagnostics are raised by SessionSpec/ApprovalPolicy and parsed by SDK callers, and their bytes are deliberately byte-compatible English (the en sidecars say 'English source only ... translation requires caller-contract migration'). Translating them requires moving callers to stable codes first, which is a mechanism change, not a locale wave.
pairs.payoff: 2027-01-31 — revisit after the caller-contract migration; the entry stays until then
